original_finding_content.subject: Medium digital product seller reports leaving Etsy for Payhip after $10K revenue
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Digital product seller who earned $10K+ on Etsy left the platform due to fees eroding margins, lack of store customization, and inability to directly market to customers, switching to Payhip.
**Verbatim snippet:** "Zero Control: My store looked like every other Etsy shop. Customization was limited, and I couldn't email customers directly to share updates or promotions."
**Source:** https://purplegram.medium.com/why-i-abandoned-etsy-for-payhip-a-digital-sellers-guide-to-avoiding-listing-fees-a6586a19ca22
